scientific_integrity: A detailed complete proof is supplied and a standalone checker corroborates its chamber arithmetic. Source examinations are material-specific, with unavailable full text transparently identified; the scientific result has no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Covers Haar-oriented central planes and generic normals only, at one-third truncation of a regular tetrahedron. Does not claim a law for translated sections, other truncations, silhouettes or section area; historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Exact three-atom central-section polygon law of the regular truncated tetrahedron
